game_module: Immersion Town - Peaceful Village & Hoi An Ancient Town (2026 Edition)
description: Kịch bản hội thoại chuẩn hóa cho 4 NPC (Mark, Emma, Sarah, David) trong game nhập vai ngôn ngữ 2D kết hợp bối cảnh nông thôn hiện đại và Phố cổ Hội An.

npcs.name: Mark
npcs.location_name: Cây Đa Làng & Trạm Sạc Xe Điện (EV Charging Station)
npcs.topic: Giao thông xanh & Văn hóa hòa quyện (Green Mobility & Tradition meets Modernity)

target_vocabulary.meaning: Biểu tượng văn hóa / Địa danh nổi tiếng
Bền vững / Thân thiện với môi trường

dialogue_flow.speaker: Mark
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Hi there! My rental electric scooter is running low on battery. Is there an EV charging station nearby?
dialogue_flow.correct_response: Yes, right here! It's located next to the historic banyan tree.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Mark
dialogue_flow.npc_text: A high-tech charger next to a 100-year-old tree? That's an amazing contrast! Is this tree a famous local landmark?

helper_prompt.definition: Địa danh / Biểu tượng văn hóa nổi tiếng của địa phương

dialogue_flow.sample_correct_response: Yes! It represents our village history, but today we also use it as a green space for sustainable tourism.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Mark
dialogue_flow.npc_text: I love how this village balances tradition and modernity! How do I start charging my scooter?
dialogue_flow.target_speech: Just scan the VietQR code on the charger with your app. It's completely free for tourists!

npcs.name: Emma
npcs.location_name: OCOP & Paddy Field View Cafe (Cà Phê View Đồng Lúa)
npcs.topic: Nông sản OCOP, Truy xuất nguồn gốc & Lối sống Du mục kỹ thuật số (Organic Produce, Traceability & Digital Nomad)

target_vocabulary.meaning: Người du mục kỹ thuật số (vừa du lịch vừa làm việc từ xa)
Bao bì thân thiện với môi trường
Khả năng truy xuất nguồn gốc (qua mã QR)

dialogue_flow.speaker: Emma
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Hey! What a breathtaking paddy field view! Do you have high-speed Wi-Fi here? I'm working as a digital nomad today.

options.text: Welcome! We have fast Wi-Fi and solar-powered outlets at every table. What drink would you like to order?
Sorry, we don't have internet. Only tea is served.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Emma
dialogue_flow.npc_text: An iced coconut coffee, please! By the way, what are these beautifully packaged jars on the display shelf? Are they local specialty products?

helper_prompt.definition: Sản phẩm đặc sản địa phương được chứng nhận chất lượng (OCOP)

dialogue_flow.sample_correct_response: Yes! Those are our village's OCOP organic lotus tea and dried fruits with eco-friendly packaging.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Emma
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Oh, there's a QR code printed on the box! Does it allow traceability of the ingredients?
dialogue_flow.target_speech: Exactly! You can scan it to see which organic farm in our village harvested the lotus.

npcs.name: Sarah
npcs.role: Du khách Đức / Đam mê Thời trang & Văn hóa
npcs.location_name: Tiệm May Áo Dài Lấy Ngay Hoi An (Hoi An Express Tailor Shop)
npcs.topic: May đo Áo Dài & Chất liệu Lụa Tơ tằm (Custom Tailoring & Mulberry Silk)

target_vocabulary.meaning: May đo theo yêu cầu riêng
Buổi thử đồ / Lần thử áo

dialogue_flow.speaker: Sarah
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Hello! I am leaving Hoi An tomorrow evening. Is it really possible to get a custom-tailored Ao Dai made in less than 24 hours?
dialogue_flow.correct_response: Yes, absolutely! Hoi An is famous for express tailoring services.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Sarah
dialogue_flow.npc_text: That's wonderful! What type of silk fabric do you recommend for a lightweight summer Ao Dai?

helper_prompt.definition: Vải lụa tơ tằm tự nhiên nhẹ mát, thích hợp may áo truyền thống

dialogue_flow.sample_correct_response: I recommend natural Mulberry silk fabric because it's soft, breathable, and elegant.

dialogue_flow.speaker: Sarah
dialogue_flow.npc_text: I love this yellow silk! When should I come back for my first fitting after taking my measurements?
dialogue_flow.target_speech: We will take your measurements now, and you can come back this evening for your first fitting!

npcs.name: Professor David
npcs.role: Nhà nghiên cứu Văn hóa Úc
npcs.location_name: Xưởng Làm Lồng Đèn Thủ Công Sông Hoài (Hoi An Lantern & Eco-Wish Workshop)
npcs.topic: Nghệ thuật Lồng đèn Dân gian & Hoa đăng Sinh thái (Lantern Craftsmanship & Eco-Wish Ceremony)

target_vocabulary.meaning: Tay nghề thủ công tinh xảo
Phân hủy sinh học (thân thiện với sông hồ)
Lễ nghi thả hoa đăng cầu nguyện

dialogue_flow.speaker: David
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Good day! I admire the traditional craftsmanship of these lanterns. Can tourists learn how to assemble a folding lantern here?

options.text: Welcome! Our master artisan will guide you to shape the bamboo frame and stretch the silk fabric.
Sorry, these are only for display and not for making.

dialogue_flow.speaker: David
dialogue_flow.npc_text: Fascinating! I plan to join the night wishing ceremony on Hoai River. Are these floating lanterns eco-friendly?

helper_prompt.definition: Có khả năng phân hủy sinh học tự nhiên, không gây ô nhiễm nguồn nước

dialogue_flow.sample_correct_response: Yes! All our river lanterns are made of biodegradable paper and bamboo to protect Hoai River.

dialogue_flow.speaker: David
dialogue_flow.npc_text: That is wonderful environmental care! Can I fold this silk lantern flat to pack into my suitcase as a souvenir?
dialogue_flow.target_speech: Yes, you can easily fold it flat to pack into your suitcase as a unique souvenir!
